name: Fleet Atlas
notes: Local-space flight uses a fixed 60 Hz physics step with display interpolation, so the ship no longer jumps when a frame is late.
The chase camera follows in real time instead of a per-frame 0.09 lerp, so 30 / 60 / 120 Hz panels keep the same on-screen lag.
Star photospheres stay at the sharp 384 px Fleet Atlas cache and no longer rebuild 192→512 when zoom or DPR changes. Sky washes are cached; huge high-DPR canvases stay on a pixel budget.
Planet Atlas, Fleet Atlas, docking, scooping, and combat are unchanged. Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.15.5.
